dataset: APTOS 2019 (held-out val split, N=400, stratified seed=42)
note: Preprocessing: crop black borders -> resize 380x380 -> ImageNet normalisation. No Ben Graham applied (preprocess_fundus_image does not apply ben_graham_preprocess). argmax = argmax over 5 classes; threshold = P(class2+3+4) >= 0.5.
